name: texturecraft-for-claude
description: Let Claude paint, bake, inspect and screenshot in the TextureCraft app you have open.
long_description:
An unofficial community extension that connects Claude to TextureCraft, the open-source 3D texture painting app from ArtCraft, through TextureCraft's own MCP server (texturecraft-cli).

Start TextureCraft with `--control 7878` (for example from a desktop shortcut). Claude can then inspect the session and layer stack, run any TextureCraft command, bake mesh maps, paint strokes, use menus and take screenshots of the viewport or the whole window.

The extension finds texturecraft-cli by itself and reconnects when TextureCraft is started or restarted after Claude, so the order you open them in doesn't matter.

tools.name: session_inspect
tools.description: The whole session as JSON: project, mesh, texture sets and the layer stack

tools.description: List TextureCraft's commands with their parameters

tools.description: Run any TextureCraft command by id

tools.name: bake
tools.description: Bake mesh maps (ambient occlusion, curvature, thickness and more)

tools.name: viewport_screenshot
tools.description: Screenshot of the app's 3D or 2D viewport

texturecraft_cli.title: TextureCraft CLI (optional)
texturecraft_cli.description: Leave empty to find it automatically. Otherwise choose texturecraft-cli.exe in your TextureCraft folder (C:\Program Files\TextureCraft by default).
